BiblicalUsage: Trembling takes hold on the mighty men of Moab at the Red Sea, and fearfulness surprises the hypocrites in Zion. The word is the shudder itself.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the trembling that takes hold of Edom and Moab is the fear of God, and it melts Canaan away.
RelatedEvents: The Exodus and the Red Sea
